name: Joe W. Bowers Jr.
office: Inglewood Unified School District, Member, Board of Education, Trustee Area 2

items.text: Joe W. Bowers Jr., a contributing editor for California Black Media, is running for Trustee Area 2. He previously worked in executive leadership at IBM, Exxon Research and Engineering, and The Coca-Cola Company. He co-founded the Education Equity Coalition and serves as a liaison between the Inglewood Area Ministers Association and the school district. His campaign says he pushed for a state audit of the district's finances. His priorities include improving student achievement, supporting teachers, and preparing students for graduation.
